name: llm-wiki
description: An autonomous OKF v0.1 knowledge wiki for Claude Code — author, read, and maintain a curated knowledge bundle so each session starts smarter. Zero-config and always-on: six commands (query/capture/prune/reorganize/tend/ingest) compose a deterministic engine — writes apply directly, gated by a deterministic Doctor + secret scan and git-reversible; query/tend are read-only. Hooks give session-start index preload, blocking secret/Doctor guards, and end-of-turn capture.
